title: features-notes/1: what the recipe of `mzlab-cli features` chose for each file, written at `--notes PATH` or beside `--out`
description: One entry per input file, in the order given: the axis of the recipe (one for the series), its unit-resolution numbers (0 on the ppm axis), the MS1 scans counted on that file and its notices. The notices are the `notices` member of estimates/1 for the same file, with the same bytes. Code: crates/mzlab-cli/src/features_note.rs, crates/mzlab-ops/src/run/feat/lr_note.rs.

file.description: the path as given, or NAME@ID for a sample selected with --sample

defect.description: channel centre offset, Da (0 on the ppm axis)

notices.description: lang keys with their whole-number parameters, empty when there is nothing to say
